assessment.behaviour_change: EditorComponent.ngOnInit now loads the article and current user only when the route has a slug. Before, /editor (new article) called GET /api/articles/undefined and then redirected or errored. ShowAuthedDirective now creates its view only once, guarded by authRef, so repeated auth emissions no longer stack duplicate views. authRef is never reset after clear(), so after logout and a second login (or the reverse) the gated view may not come back. This affects persistent components such as the header.
